en.text:
Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.

Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to #e<pve #pve /> <pvp [#pvp] /> Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.

Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.

#e Increases Sticky Bomb damage.
